genxml.title: The wired-entry layout IRIX uses in the R10000 TLB
genxml.from: IRIX kernel translation-handling reading, one release outside the shipped-binary inventory; the R10000 geometry was not checked against the published manual
genxml.doc: Software table, not a register map: the wired-entry layout and the page and ASID policy IRIX uses in its 64-bit kernel. The TLB entry count and ASID width of the R10000 itself are in the chips repository (unit r10000_cp0). Prose and the reasoning are in formats/r10k_tlb/README.md.
